title: DemoHistory
description: A declared history for a demonstration (ADR 0216): the work items of an existing project, the states they went through, the runs and costs of their agents, the decisions people took and the findings raised. `POST /projects/{id}/demo-history` takes it in on an instance that opted in; every row it writes is marked as imported and counts in no budget. Each object carries an `id` of its own: re-importing the same document changes nothing, and an id that already holds other content is refused.

workflow.description: The project's workflow the work items belong to, by name; absent: the project's default. Every state the document names must exist in it.

prices.description: The price the document declares for each model, in USD per million tokens. A run that gives no `cost_usd` is costed with the price of its `model`; a model with no price there is refused.

id.description: The external id: what makes the import idempotent. Unique in its list (for runs, decisions and findings: in its work item).

cached_input_usd_per_mtok.description: The price of the input tokens read from a cache; absent: the input price.

by.description: Who moved it: an e-mail of a member of the organisation, or an agent slug of its registry; absent: the orchestrator.

input.description: All the input tokens, the cached ones included.

cached.description: The part of `input` read from a cache.

stage.description: The role of the step the run played (`refine`, `implement`, `review`...).

agent.description: The slug of an agent of the organisation's registry; refused when the registry does not hold it.

cost_usd.description: The cost as declared; absent: the tokens at the price of `model` in `prices`.

by.description: The e-mail of a member of the organisation; refused otherwise.

approved.description: An approval or a scope change: granted or refused.

pending.description: A request that still waits for a person: after the import the inbox lists it and an approver decides it through the usual decision route. Deciding it records the decision (audited) and closes the request; no workflow runs an imported work item, so nothing follows from it: no agent runs and nothing is written outside the platform. Refused on a work item in a terminal state.

requested_at.description: When it was asked; not before the work item was created.

due_at.description: When it is due, after `requested_at`; absent: 24 hours after it.

type.description: A finding type the project's workflow allows: the core's, the plugins' or its own `metadata.finding_types` (ADR 0217), judged by the import as the finding routes judge an agent's; the severity must fit the type's scale.

run.description: The id of the run of this work item that raised it.

fields.description: The ticket's fields, validated by the workflow's `metadata.inputs` as a live ticket's are.

created_by.description: The e-mail of a member of the organisation; refused otherwise.

state.description: The state it is in now; absent: the last of `history`, else the workflow's initial state.

history.description: The states it went through, oldest first, from the initial state. The last one is the current state.

pending.description: What the work item waits for now, if a person must decide: at most one.
